human_review: The thesis author reports that a sleep expert completed review of both datasets and confirmed the supplied final content.
basis: Author-reported completion; no retrospective item-level decisions have been manufactured.
final_content: Knowledge follows the saved AI-revised set. Clinical follows the saved source-based cases. The author reported no further content changes at human review.
interface: New reviews use the accept/reject/correct interface in notebooks 02 and 03. Every item needs an explicit decision before export.
public_projection: Question and reference-answer content is preserved. Verbatim evidence excerpts and internal authoring metadata are omitted. Source names and page references remain.
automated_answer_scoring: Separate from dataset review. The supplied clinical results use the recorded Gemini and GLM labels; they are not a per-response expert scoring ledger.
